jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. About our Team: Micron’s Industrial and Physical AI team is transforming semiconductor manufacturing through the application of AI, automation, and intelligent operations. Our team develops and deploys innovative solutions across Micron’s global manufacturing network, enabling engineers and operators to make faster, smarter, and more data-driven decisions. Position Overview: We are seeking an early-career Full-Stack AI Engineer to help design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications that support Micron’s Autonomous Operations initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to work across the full technology stack, including AI models, data pipelines, APIs, web applications, cloud infrastructure, and manufacturing system integrations, to deliver impactful solutions used across global manufacturing operations. Responsibilities: Design, develop, and support end-to-end AI applications, including data pipelines, feature engineering, model inference, APIs, user interfaces, and monitoring capabilities. Build responsive front-end applications using React, Angular, or Streamlit and develop backend services using Python and FastAPI. Integrate Generative AI technologies, including LLMs and agentic workflows, into manufacturing applications and operational processes. Collaborate on the integration of robotics platforms, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), automation systems, and manufacturing execution systems (MES). Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, and CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions. Implement monitoring, evaluation, drift detection, and feedback mechanisms to ensure reliable and scalable AI solutions in production environments. Apply Responsible AI and software engineering standards, including security, audit logging, model governance, and performance optimization. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 2+ years of experience developing and deploying production software applications, AI solutions, or related technologies. Proficiency in Python and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development. Experience working with SQL and relational database technologies. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Experience using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines to deploy and manage applications. Working knowledge of Generative AI concepts, including prompt engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, agentic workflows, and AI model evaluation practices. Preferred Qualifications: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Experience building full-stack web applications using React, Angular, Streamlit, FastAPI, or similar modern frameworks. Familiarity with MLOps or LLMOps practices, including model monitoring, deployment, evaluation, and lifecycle management. Experience integrating AI solutions with robotics, automation systems, IoT devices, or manufacturing applications. Knowledge of container orchestration, cloud-native architectures, and GPU-accelerated AI workloads. Understanding of Responsible AI, cybersecurity, data privacy, and model governance principles. Prior experience in semiconductor manufacturing, advanced manufacturing, industrial automation, or other regulated high-reliability environments. As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits . Micron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. To learn about your right to work click here. To learn more about Micron, please visit micron.com/careers For US Sites Only: To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact Micron’s People Organization at hrsupport_na@micron.com or 1-800-336-8918 (select option #3) Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards. Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron. AI alert : Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification. Fraud alert: Micron advises job seekers to be cautious of unsolicited job offers and to verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Micron by checking the official Micron careers website in the About Micron Technology, Inc.

jobs.description: If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/ About Us: Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process. About the Role The Community Growth organization is driving measurable audience growth, engagement, and revenue for our streamers while delivering exceptional experiences that delight our viewers. Our mission is to design smarter tools, seamless pathways between discovery and support, and meaningful opportunities that connect people to what they love most about Twitch. These features let people participate in their favorite communities and discover new ones more efficiently. We work hard to bring novel opportunities to the world of streaming both individually and in collaboration with similar streamers. Some examples of spaces we own include Chat, Stream Together, and Discovery. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone. What you get to do in this role: Build the best cloud software for businesses using a market leading development cloud platform. Collaborate daily with a team of like-minded developers using agile software development methodology. Master new areas and take ownership of features that matter to our customers. jobs.description: The Velocity Labs team mission is to think beyond the confines of the normal product-orientated approach and to discover new ways to apply and embrace agentic AI. We are looking for people who are hands-on builders, have strong curiosity, strong bias for action, and maintain high standards.
